//: This app is listed in the ROOT tsconfig's `exclude`, because the root
config covers packages/ballistics-core only. That exclusion is inherited
through `extends`, and it removes this app's own files from the build -
producing `TS18003: No inputs were found` even with correct globs.
Re-declaring `exclude` here replaces the inherited list, so these two
dirs are the only exclusions. `allowJs` is required or the .js/.jsx files
in hooks/, screens/ and services/ are silently skipped.
`_unscreens/` holds screens that are not wired into the navigator and
import packages this app does not depend on. See _unscreens/README.md.
